description: React component for the checkout page of a food delivery web application, handling order placement, address selection, payment methods, and map display.

methods.name: calculateTip
methods.description: Calculates the tip amount based on selected tip percentage, total price, delivery charges, and tax.

methods.name: taxCalculation
methods.description: Calculates the tax amount based on the tax rate and total price.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles actions after successful order placement, including analytics tracking and navigation based on payment method.

methods.name: calculatePrice
methods.description: Calculates total price of items in cart including delivery charges and discounts.

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates the overall total including items, delivery, tax, and tip.

methods.name: transformOrder
methods.description: Transforms cart data into order input format for GraphQL mutation.

methods.name: checkPaymentMethod
methods.description: Validates if the selected payment method supports the current currency.

methods.name: onPayment
methods.description: Initiates the order mutation with current order details if payment method and currency are valid.

methods.name: locationCallback
methods.description: Handles the result of geolocation fetch, updating address state.

methods.name: getCurrentLocation
methods.description: Fetches current geolocation and updates address accordingly.

methods.name: validateOrder
methods.description: Validates if the order can be placed, checking restaurant availability, cart, address, payment, and user profile.
